interpretations: "Tally the projects" means the number of QC records (rows) per archstat value, including duplicate projects.
"Tally the projects" means the number of distinct projects (distinct arcref) per archstat value.
A missing status is NULL archstat only, and it forms its own group labeled NULL or "Missing".
A missing status includes both NULL and empty-string archstat values, grouped together as one missing group.
A missing status means NULL and empty string are two separate groups.
Share is each tally divided by the total of all tallies. If a project is counted under several statuses, the total can exceed the number of distinct projects.
Share is each tally divided by the total number of distinct projects overall.
Share is a fraction between 0 and 1.
Share is a percentage between 0 and 100.
The average share is the mean of the per-status shares, which equals 1 divided by the number of statuses.
The average share is the overall mean tally divided by the total, which gives the same result as interpretation 10.
The average share is computed over the statuses including the missing group.
The average share is computed over only the non-missing statuses.
"Above the average share" means strictly greater than the average, so statuses equal to the average are excluded.
"Above the average share" means greater than or equal to the average.
"How far above" is the absolute difference, share minus average share.
"How far above" is the relative difference, (share − average) / average.
"How far above" is the difference in percentage points.
"No rounding" means raw unrounded numeric values, with no ROUND or formatting.
Statuses are taken only from scanqc.archstat, with projects counted via scanqc.arcref.
Projects are counted by joining scanqc to the projects table, so only QC records whose arcref matches a project are included.
Projects are taken from the projects table, and projects with no QC record form the missing-status group.
Output columns are status, tally, share, and the difference above average, with the missing status shown as a label or as NULL.
Missing interpretations:
Tally counts distinct projects per status, and a project with several QC rows under different archstat values is counted once in each status group.
Tally counts QC rows, where each row is one project-status pair, and a project's duplicate rows are counted separately.
A missing status also covers whitespace-only archstat values, trimmed and grouped with the missing group.
A missing status also covers placeholder strings such as "N/A" or "Unknown", grouped with the missing group.
Statuses are compared case-sensitively, so "Verified" and "verified" are separate groups.
Statuses are compared after trimming whitespace and normalizing case, so variants merge into one group.
The share denominator is the sum of the tallies, which is the QC row count if rows are tallied.
The share denominator is the sum of per-status distinct-project tallies, which can exceed the distinct project count.
The average share is computed only over statuses that have a nonzero tally, which is the groups that appear in the data.
The average share is computed over all possible statuses from the documentation ("Verified", "Pending") plus the missing group, including statuses with zero tally.
The difference above average is the share minus the average share, expressed as a fraction.
The difference above average is the share minus the average share, expressed as a percentage.

Ties and floating-point equality: a share equal to the average is excluded or included depending on the strict or non-strict reading, and an integer-division risk means the share must be computed with a decimal cast.
The output is ordered by tally descending or by difference descending.
The output is ordered by status name.
queries: SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat
SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat
SELECT COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing') AS archstat, COUNT(*) FROM scanqc GROUP BY COALESCE(archstat, 'Missing');
